summary: Yimutian Inc., a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing supplemental agreements dated September 9, 2026 that amend consideration for two August 20, 2026 purchase agreements. It is acquiring control of 100% of Qingdao Xingongguan Holiday Hotel via VIE agreements for US$5.8 million, and certain Zhaodong, Heilongjiang land, buildings and equipment from Zhaodong Guohe for US$21,161,390. Both are stock-funded; share counts were revised sharply upward to an adjusted US$2.192 per ADS. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch dilution and ratio mechanics.
